title: Paris knife attack: Man arrested after three women stabbed near Porte de Clichy
summary: Three women were stabbed near Porte de Clichy in Paris, one of whom was reported to be pregnant. Police detained a suspect at the scene and opened an investigation. Authorities are treating the case as a violent assault while seeking a motive and any witnesses.
content:
Three women were reportedly stabbed near Porte de Clichy in northern Paris, authorities said. The victims included a pregnant woman. Emergency services provided first aid and transported the injured to nearby hospitals for treatment.

Police moved quickly after the incident and detained a man at or near the scene. Officers said the suspect was arrested without a prolonged pursuit, and he is currently being held for questioning as investigators work to establish the circumstances of the attack.

Investigators have not publicly identified a motive and are examining whether the attack was random, targeted, or linked to another factor. Detectives are reviewing CCTV footage from the area and appealing for witnesses to come forward with information that could clarify the sequence of events.

Local emergency services and hospital sources confirmed that the victims were stabilised and receiving care; officials have not released detailed information about their conditions beyond noting the presence of a pregnant woman among the injured. Authorities said they will provide updates as more information becomes available.

The Porte de Clichy area is a busy transport and commercial hub in Paris, and news of the stabbings prompted heightened police presence in the neighbourhood while detectives carried out forensic work at the scene. City officials urged calm and cooperation with the ongoing investigation.

The detained suspect is expected to be formally questioned and may face further legal action depending on the findings of the police inquiry and prosecutors. Anyone with relevant footage or information was asked to contact investigators to assist in piecing together what happened.
